correctness.rationale: Parametrize every -S translation by barycentric upper caps b_i with sum 2; fixed-cap Brunn–Minkowski concavity of overlap^(1/2) and swapping the other caps proves the symmetric global optimizer. The exact overlap inclusion–exclusion in the uniform simplex yields F(s)=2s−3s²/2 for 0≤s≤1 and (2−s)²/2 for 1≤s≤2, maximized at 2/3 with F=2/3. Exclusion is a strict b_i<λ_i(y) inequality, whose supremum equals the boundary value by continuity. Since max λ_i≥1/3, maximizing over excluded caps yields d(y)=1−2t+3t²/2, t=min(max λ_i,2/3) for ALL plane points. The level halfspaces reflect S around its centroid; inclusion in S starts at u=1/2 (depth 3/8), while the Dirichlet simplex law gives both survival branches and a mass-1/3 atom at depth 1/3. Independently verified 201 rational cap-integral identities and endpoint thresholds; finite checks are supplementary.
